# dnswiz_notification_channel (Resource)

A destination for dnswiz notifications. Today only webhook is supported.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "dnswiz_notification_channel" "oncall" {
  name   = "oncall-webhook"
  kind   = "webhook"
  target = "https://hooks.example.com/dnswiz"
  events = [
    "endpoint.down",
    "endpoint.up",
    "hijack.detected",
    "cert.expiring",
  ]
}

# The signing secret is only returned once at create time. Save it
# wherever your webhook receiver verifies HMAC signatures.
output "channel_secret" {
  value     = dnswiz_notification_channel.oncall.secret
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `events` (List of String) Event types that fire this channel.
- `kind` (String) Channel kind. Only `webhook` is supported.
- `name` (String) Human-readable channel name.
- `target` (String) Webhook URL.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the channel is dispatched. Defaults to `true`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) HMAC signing secret returned by dnswiz on create. The server never returns it again, so this attribute stays null on subsequent reads.
